name: krallik
description: Krallık Simülasyonu — LLM-yönetimli, kalıcı, çok oyunculu ortaçağ krallık oyunu

scripts.build: npm run build -w @krallik/shared && npm run build -w @krallik/server && npm run build -w @krallik/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @krallik/shared && npm run typecheck -w @krallik/server && npm run typecheck -w @krallik/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @krallik/shared && npm run test -w @krallik/server
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n tsc,api,tick,web -c gray,cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:watch" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:tick" "npm:dev:web"
